mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_homework_remind_log (homework_id, student_id, remind_type, deadline, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{row.homeworkId}, #{row.studentId}, #{row.remindType}, #{row.deadline}, COALESCE(#{operator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), COALESCE(#{operator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu_homework_remind_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{id}
